sentences.text: Rule twenty-five covers sailing vessels and rowing boats.
A sailing vessel underway shows sidelights and a sternlight, and no masthead light.
On a sailing vessel under twenty meters, those lights may be combined in one tricolor lantern at or near the top of the mast, where they’re easier to see over waves.
A sailing vessel may also show two all-round lights at or near the masthead, red over green, in addition to her sidelights and sternlight.
Remember: red over green, sailing machine.
But those optional lights may not be shown together with the tricolor lantern.
